description: Shared z-score helper used by compute_demand, compute_competition_density and build_opportunity_matrix, with the module's own zero-variance guard baked in (z=0 rather than NaN/division-by-zero).
docstring:
Compute a z-score over the scored cluster population.

Args:
    series: A numeric Series, one value per scored (i.e. >= min_cluster_size) archetype for the current run.

Returns:
    (series - series.mean()) / series.std(ddof=0), except when series.std(ddof=0) == 0 (all values identical, including the single-cluster case), in which case every value is 0.0 rather than NaN, per the module's own invariant 'Zero-variance feature when computing z-scores -> z defined as 0 for all clusters rather than a division by zero'.
preconditions: series has at least one entry
postconditions: Result has the same index and length as series
If series has nonzero variance, mean(result) == 0.0 within floating-point tolerance

edge_cases.input: series with all identical values (zero variance)

edge_cases.expected_behavior: zero variance by definition (std of a single value is 0); returns [0.0]
propagates NaN only at that entry's position; mean/std are computed excluding NaN (pandas default skipna=True) so a single missing archetype value does not poison every other archetype's z-score

unit_tests.name: test_standard_zscore_computation
unit_tests.description: A series with known mean/std produces the standard z-score formula's result.
unit_tests.expected: z-scores summing to ~0, matching manual computation

unit_tests.name: test_zero_variance_returns_all_zero
unit_tests.description: A series of identical values returns all 0.0, not NaN.
